title: MpiAspectRatio - rename ratio output to string, add a 2-slot MPI_PACK output; add Mpi Packer 2 / Unpacker 2
description: Node-pack work in the sibling repo ComfyUi-MpiNodes. (1) MpiAspectRatio's STRING output is labelled 'ratio'; rename to 'string' to match the logic.py convention. (2) Append a second output of the existing MPI_PACK type carrying 2 slots. (3) Create MpiPacker2/MpiUnpacker2 as _count=2 subclasses of the existing MpiPacker/MpiUnpacker in switches.py. Ends in changelog.md + README.md rows, a push, and a dev_configs/node_lock.json pin bump.
